item.title: GLSEN has become Glisten
item.description: GLSEN, the non-profit organization advocating for LGBTQ+ youth in K-12 education, announced last week that the organization has rebranded as Glisten, with the new name “reflecting the organization’s evolving commitment to visibility, clarity and support for LGBTQ+ youth nationwide,” according to a Feb. 6 press release. item.title: BREAKING: Arlington council approves ‘meet and refer’ anti-discrimination ordinance, leaving city residents unprotected
item.description: The Arlington City Council tonight (Tuesday, Feb. 10) approved a proposed anti-discrimination ordinance that, many believe, in effect leaves the city’s minority residents without any protection against discrimination.
